cards.card_text: Then Paul gets practical: when Timothy comes, bring the cloak Paul left with Carpus at Troas, and his scrolls, especially the parchments.
cards.verse_text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
cards.snippet: …that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
